step_by_step_reasoning: Based on the visual whiteboard diagram, the architecture is divided into two main sections: SMARTSTACK (the control/orchestration plane) and USC (the deployed commerce platform). On the SMARTSTACK side, we have an actor (Developer / User) who connects to the ALB and S3 bucket via physically drawn green arrows. Within SMARTSTACK, Lambda functions have a downward arrow pointing to DynamoDB and a curved arrow pointing to CodeBuild. There is also a green line extending from the DynamoDB area across the vertical boundary to the USC side. The USC side displays S3, Aurora, ECR, ECS, and ELB as independent nodes without internal lines.

graph.name: Ultraserve SmartStack and USC Architecture
graph.notes: SmartStack orchestrates the creation and deployment of the USC digital commerce platform on AWS using Lambda, DynamoDB, CodeBuild, and Terraform.

nodes.name: Developer / User
nodes.notes: Interacts with SmartStack via the UI, API, or CI/CD pipelines.

nodes.name: ALB
nodes.notes: Exposes REST APIs for the control plane.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Stateless microservices that coordinate deployment logic and trigger CodeBuild.

nodes.name: CodeBuild
nodes.notes: Executes Terraform scripts to provision the USC environment.

nodes.name: S3 (SmartStack)
nodes.notes: S3 bucket used to poll for custom code updates and deployment artifacts.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores state and persistence configuration data.

nodes.name: S3 (USC)
nodes.notes: Deployed S3 resource for USC storage.

nodes.name: Aurora
nodes.notes: Relational database within the deployed USC commerce environment.

nodes.name: ECR
nodes.notes: Stores container images for deployment onto ECS.

nodes.name: ECS
nodes.notes: Container service hosting the USC applications.

nodes.name: ELB
nodes.notes: Load balances incoming customer traffic to USC containers.

edges.notes: Developer sends control plane and UI requests to the ALB.
Developer pushes custom code or updates into the S3 bucket.
Lambda microservices write configuration state to DynamoDB.
Lambda triggers CodeBuild execution with dynamic Terraform templates.
Provisioning state/context transfers across the SmartStack to USC boundary.
